name: Streaming media (HLS & DASH)
description: Downloads adaptive streams — HLS (.m3u8) and MPEG-DASH (.mpd): lists the qualities the stream offers, downloads the chosen (or best) one as segments, and assembles them into a playable file (AES-128 decrypt, concat, and ffmpeg remux or video+audio mux). FFmpeg is auto-downloaded on first use.

name: Website offline copy
description: Save a web page — or a whole site — for offline reading: adds an “Offline copy (.zip)” option when you paste a page link. Pages, styles, scripts, images and fonts are captured with links rewritten for offline viewing, packaged as a single .zip. No extra tools needed.

name: Video sites (YouTube and others)
description: Downloads the video behind a page on YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok, Vimeo and other video sites: lists the available qualities, downloads the chosen one, and assembles it into a playable file. It uses the browser session the Downloader extension sends with a link — never the cookies stored in your browser. The extraction tool and FFmpeg are downloaded and checksum-verified on first use.
